issues.description: CHANGELOG name mismatch: entry says compute_image_not_publicly_shared but PR title says compute_image_publicly_shared
issues.detail: The PR description repeatedly references compute_image_publicly_shared/ directory, but the actual code and CHANGELOG use compute_image_not_publicly_shared. Pick one. Inconsistency between description and shipped artifact wastes the next reviewer's time and breaks anyone grepping for the check name. Low cost to fix, high signal on care.

issues.description: Bare Exception catch with traceback introspection inside hot per-image loop
issues.detail: except Exception as error: ... error.__traceback__.tb_lineno is sloppy. A permission-denied on getIamPolicy is a known, expected condition (HttpError 403), not a mystery. Catch the specific googleapiclient HttpError, branch on status, log denied-vs-real-failure differently. A silent publicly_shared=False on auth failure is a false PASS — that is a security-check bug, not a logging nit.

issues.description: Failure to fetch IAM policy is reported as PASS, masking real exposure
issues.detail: If getIamPolicy raises (permission denied, transient 5xx, network), publicly_shared stays False and the check emits PASS. A security check that turns 'I could not determine' into 'safe' is worse than no check. Track an unknown/error state and surface it, or refuse to emit a finding for that image. Compare test-image-3 in the fixture — it silently passes.

issues.description: Per-image getIamPolicy call with no concurrency on what could be thousands of images
issues.detail: Every other collector in this service uses __threading_call__. _get_images iterates project_ids serially and fires one synchronous getIamPolicy per image. On a project with hundreds of custom images this will dominate scan time. Either thread it the way the rest of the file does, or document why this one is special. Matching the codebase's voice matters.

issues.description: Check only inspects allAuthenticatedUsers; bindings with public roles via groups or domain not considered
issues.detail: Comment correctly notes allUsers is API-restricted on images, fine. But IAM bindings can grant broad access via domain:* or large groups; the check label 'publicly shared' is narrower than the name suggests. Either rename to allAuthenticatedUsers-specific or extend. Not blocking — the current scope is defensible — but the doc string should match what the code actually detects.

issues.description: Image model missing fields other checks will need (labels, location, family, source)
issues.detail: Shipping a minimal Image model with just name/id/project_id/publicly_shared means the next check that needs image metadata duplicates collection or extends the model in a second PR. Not a refusal — earn abstraction by duplication — but if a follow-up check is planned, the shape will change. Fine as one patch; flag for awareness.

review.summary: The patch does one thing, the diff is scoped, the tests cover the obvious cases — that's the good news. The bad: a security check that swallows getIamPolicy failures and emits PASS is a false-negative factory, and the test fixture's test-image-3 demonstrates exactly that silent failure mode without asserting on it. Bare Exception with traceback introspection where googleapiclient.HttpError is the obvious specific catch. No threading where every sibling collector in the same file uses __threading_call__ — matches neither the codebase's voice nor scales. Name inconsistency between PR description and shipped artifact is a small thing that signals lack of care. NEEDS-WORK: fix the error-state-as-PASS bug, narrow the exception, and either thread the collection or justify why not.
